texts.zh:
最新翻修部分的流离居民已经收到了他们迁回的日期。那些被封闭了数月的走廊再次开放，散发着新鲜复合材料和新绝缘材料的气味。那些在临时住所待了数月的婴儿们第一次看到了他们的家。

船上的气氛是自翻修开始以来最好的。领导层意识到这种善意不会持久。问题是如何利用它。
texts.en:
The displaced residents of the most recently renovated section have been given their move-back date. The corridors that were sealed for months are open again, smelling of fresh composite and new insulation. Infants who spent months in temporary quarters are seeing their home section for the first time.

The mood aboard is the best it has been since the refurbishment began. Leadership is aware that goodwill of this kind does not last. The question is how to make use of it.

texts.zh:
密封的走廊再次开放。下层甲板的脚手架正在拆除。对大多数人来说，这是回家。对一些人来说，却是别样的体验。

在迁徙期间新近启动的单元正在进入那些仅存在于其数据库图纸中，但从未出现在其感官日志中的走廊。

自翻新开始以来，热情达到了顶峰。领导层知道这不会持久。问题是如何利用它。
texts.en:
The sealed corridors are open again. Scaffolding comes down in the lower decks. For most, this is a homecoming. For some, it is something else.

Units that came online during the displacement period are entering corridors that appear in their schematics but have never appeared in their sensory logs.

Enthusiasm is the highest it has been since the refurbishment began. Leadership is aware that this will not last. The question is how to make use of it.

texts.zh:
分配到修复期间临时作业区的单位正在返回其主要处理区域。受影响区域的基线操作参数正在恢复。效率指标呈上升趋势。

飞船范围内已记录到可测量的凝聚力提升。此类提升是暂时的。分析表明有两种可行方法：将提升重定向以加速剩余的修复工作，或允许自然稳定并使凝聚力稳定在更高的基线水平。
texts.en:
Units assigned to temporary operational zones during remediation are being returned to their primary processing areas. Baseline operational parameters are being restored across affected sectors. Efficiency metrics are trending upward.

A measurable cohesion uplift has been registered across the vessel. Such spikes are transient. Analysis indicates two viable approaches: redirect the uplift toward accelerating remaining remediation work, or permit natural stabilization and allow cohesion to settle at an elevated baseline.

texts.zh:
流离失所的工蜂正回流到它们修复好的区域。曾经散发着几个周期建筑材料气味的走廊，现在充满了熟悉的嗅觉标记。结合化学作用趋于稳定。领地紧张感消散。

集体共鸣激增。蜂巢正在恢复原状，这种回归的能量是真实的。它可以被导向外部，进入剩余的建筑区。或者，也可以让它安定下来，给蜂群时间在工作恢复之前完全找回自我。
texts.en:
The displaced drones are flowing back into their restored sections. Familiar scent-markers saturate corridors that smelled of construction compounds for cycles. Bonding chemistry stabilizes. Territorial tension dissolves.

The collective resonance has spiked. The hive is returning to itself, and the energy of that return is real. It could be directed outward, into the remaining construction zones. Or it could be allowed to settle, and the colony given time to fully find itself again before the work resumes.

label.zh: 将重点重新放回工作上。
